title: Tech Stocks Going To ZERO: 'The Whole Thing Is Going To Collapse' | George Noble
speaker: George Noble (guest), David Lin (host)

macro_themes.view: The financing architecture of AI (OpenAI/Anthropic funding rounds, neocloud debt) is coming apart and the whole edifice will collapse.
Cost of capital is rising everywhere; avoid indebted, high-P/E, long-duration companies and own cash-flow and inflation beneficiaries.
PE-controlled life insurers (Athene, Prudential, Equitable, MetLife) are overleveraged in illiquid related-party assets; a crisis is developing.
Government incentive to prop up stocks and suppress oil fades after the election, so volatility should rise.
Indices are held up by a few big names; average stock is down ~15% from highs; it is a stock-picker's market.

calls.reason: $55B debt, ROIC 8.9% below borrowing cost, bonds yielding ~15%, retail piling in; 'WeWork with GPUs'; expects bankruptcy. Short from 107, added at ~81.

calls.reason: Neoclouds (IREN, NBIS, CIFR) are the most leveraged part of AI infrastructure; bond market signals equity near worthless; NBIS 'best of the lot'.
calls.quote: It's not just CoreWeave, it's IREN, it's NBIS, it's CIFR... NBIS is the best of the lot
